40021846.author: पदार्थः
40021846.content: तथा thus, सञ्चोदितः urged, सूतः the charioteer, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, महात्मना by the great-souled, तत् that, वाक्यम् words, ऋषिणा by the sage, प्रोक्तम् spoken, व्याहर्तुम् to narrate, उपचक्रमे began,

40021846.author: Translation
40021846.content: Thus urged by the great-souled Lakshmana, the charioteer began to narrate the words spoken by the sage.

40021847.author: पदार्थः
40021847.content: पुरा formerly, नाम्ना by name, हि indeed, दुर्वासा Durvasa, अत्रेः of Atri, पुत्रः son, महामुनिः great sage, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, आश्रमे in the hermitage, पुण्ये sacred, वार्षिक्यम् the rainy season, समुवास resided, ह indeed,

40021847.author: Translation
40021847.content: Formerly, a great sage named Durvasa, the son of Atri, resided in the sacred hermitage of Vasishtha during the rainy season.

40021848.author: पदार्थः
40021848.content: तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, महातेजाः highly effulgent, पिता father, ते your, सुमहायशाः very famous, पुरोहितम् the priest, महात्मानम् the great-souled, दिदृक्षुः desirous of seeing, अगमत् went, अयम् this one,

40021848.author: Translation
40021848.content: Your highly effulgent and very famous father went to that hermitage, desirous of seeing the great-souled priest.

40021849.author: पदार्थः
40021849.content: सः He, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सूर्यसङ्काशं sun-like, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, इव as if, तेजसा with splendor, उपविष्टं seated, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasistha, सव्यपार्श्वे on the left side, महामुनिम् the great sage.

40021849.author: Translation
40021849.content: He (Rama) saw the great sage, who resembled the sun and blazed with splendor, seated on the left side of Vasistha.

40021850.author: पदार्थः
40021850.content: तौ those two, मुनी sages, तापसश्रेष्ठौ best among ascetics, विनीतः humbly, हि indeed, अभिवादयत् greeted. सः He, ताभ्यां by those two, पूजितः honored, राजा the king, स्वागतेन with welcome, आसनेन with a seat, च and.

40021850.author: Translation
40021850.content: The king (Rama) humbly greeted those two sages, the best among ascetics, and was honored by them with a welcome and a seat.

40021851.author: पदार्थः
40021851.content: पाद्येन with water for feet, फलमूलैः with fruits and roots, च and, उवास stayed, मुनिभिः सह with the sages.

40021851.author: Translation
40021851.content: He (Rama) stayed with the sages, having been honored with water for his feet and offerings of fruits and roots.

40021852.author: पदार्थः
40021852.content: तेषां among them, तत्रोपविष्टानां who were seated there, तास्ताः various, सुमधुराः very sweet, कथाः conversations, बभूवुः took place, परमर्षीणां among the great sages, मध्यादित्यगते when the sun was in the middle, अहनि in the day.

40021852.author: Translation
40021852.content: As they sat there, various very pleasant conversations took place among the great sages during the midday.

40021853.author: पदार्थः
40021853.content: ततः then, कथायां कस्याञ्चित् in some conversation, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रग्रहः humble, नृपः the king, उवाच spoke, तं to him, महात्मानम् the great-souled one, अत्रेः पुत्रं the son of Atri, तपोधनम् rich in asceticism.

40021853.author: Translation
40021853.content: Then, during one of the conversations, the king (Rama), with folded hands and humility, spoke to that great-souled sage, the son of Atri, who was rich in asceticism.

40021854.author: पदार्थः
40021854.content: भगवन् O revered one, किं what, प्रमाणेन by measure, मम my, वंशो lineage, भविष्यति will be, किम् what, आयुः lifespan, च and, हि indeed, मे my, रामः Rama, पुत्राः sons, च and, अन्ये others, किम् what, आयुषः of lifespan.

40021854.author: Translation
40021854.content: Dasharatha asks the sage about the extent of his lineage, the lifespan of his son Rama, and the lifespans of his other sons.

40021855.author: पदार्थः
40021855.content: रामस्य of Rama, च and, सुताः sons, ये who, स्युः may be, तेषाम् their, आयुः lifespan, कियत् how much, भवेत् may be, काम्यया with desire, भगवन् O revered one, ब्रूहि tell, वंशस्य of the lineage, अस्य this, गतिम् course, मम my.

40021855.author: Translation
40021855.content: Dasharatha further inquires about the lifespans of Rama's future sons and eagerly requests the sage to reveal the future course of his dynasty.

40021856.author: पदार्थः
40021856.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, व्याहृतम् spoken, वाक्यम् word, राज्ञः of the king, दशरथस्य Dasharatha, च and, दुर्वासाः Durvasa, सुमहातेजाः of great splendor, व्याहर्तुम् to speak, उपचक्रमे began.

40021856.author: Translation
40021856.content: Having heard the words spoken by King Dasharatha, the exceedingly powerful sage Durvasa began to reply.

40021857.author: पदार्थः
40021857.content: शृणु listen, राजन् O king, पुरावृत्तम् ancient event, तदा then, देवासुरे between gods and asuras, युधि in battle, दैत्याः demons, सुरैः by gods, भर्त्स्यमानाः being oppressed, भृगुपत्नीम् to Bhrigu's wife, समाश्रिताः took refuge.

40021857.author: Translation
40021857.content: Durvasa instructs the king to listen to an ancient event from the time of the war between gods and asuras, when the demons, being oppressed by the gods, sought refuge with Bhrigu's wife.

40021858.author: पदार्थः
40021858.content: तया by her, परिगृहीतान् protected, तान् them, दृष्ट्वा having seen, क्रुद्धः enraged, सुरेश्वरः the lord of gods, चक्रेण with the discus, शितधारेण sharp-edged, भृगुपत्न्याः of Bhrigu's wife, शिरः head, अहरत् cut off.

40021858.author: Translation
40021858.content: Seeing the demons protected by her, the enraged lord of gods (Vishnu) cut off the head of Bhrigu's wife with his sharp-edged discus.

40021859.author: पदार्थः
40021859.content: ततः then, तां her, निहतां slain, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पत्नीं wife, भृगुकुलोद्वहः the upholder of the Bhrigu lineage, शशाप cursed, सहसा suddenly, क्रुद्धो enraged, विष्णुं Vishnu, रिपुकुलार्दनम् the destroyer of the family of enemies.

40021859.author: Translation
40021859.content: Then, the enraged upholder of the Bhrigu lineage, having suddenly seen his wife slain, cursed Vishnu, the destroyer of the family of enemies.

40021860.author: पदार्थः
40021860.content: यस्मात् because, अवध्यां inviolable, मे my, पत्नीम् wife, अवधीः you killed, क्रोधमूर्च्छितः overcome by anger, तस्मात् therefore, त्वं you, मानुषे in the human, लोके world, जनिष्यसि will be born, जनार्दन O Janardana.

40021860.author: Translation
40021860.content: Because you, overcome by anger, killed my inviolable wife, therefore you, O Janardana, will be born in the human world.

40021861.author: पदार्थः
40021861.content: तत्र there, पत्नीवियोगं separation from wife, त्वं you, प्राप्स्यसे will experience, बहुवार्षिकम् for many years.

40021861.author: Translation
40021861.content: There, you will experience separation from your wife for many years.

40021862.author: पदार्थः
40021862.content: शापाभिहतचेताः whose mind was afflicted by the curse, सः he, स्वात्मना by his own self, भावितो understood/realized, अभवत् became.

40021862.author: Translation
40021862.content: Though his mind was afflicted by the curse, he (Vishnu) realized it was in accordance with his own divine will.

40021863.author: पदार्थः
40021863.content: अर्चयामास worshipped, तं that, देवं god, भृगुः Bhrigu, शापेन by the curse, पीडितः distressed, तपसा by penance, आराधितो worshipped, देवो the god, हि indeed, अब्रवीत् said, भक्तवत्सलः affectionate to his devotees, लोकानां for the worlds, संहितार्थं for the welfare, तु indeed, तं that, शापं curse, ग्राह्यं acceptable, उक्तवान् declared.

40021863.author: Translation
40021863.content: Distressed by his own curse, Bhrigu worshipped that god (Vishnu), and the god, affectionate to his devotees and propitiated by penance, indeed declared that the curse was acceptable for the welfare of the worlds.

40021864.author: पदार्थः
40021864.content: इति thus, शप्तो cursed, महातेजा the greatly effulgent one, भृगुणा by Bhrigu, पूर्वजन्मनि in a previous birth, इहागतो has come here, हि indeed, पुत्रत्वं to sonship, तव your, पार्थिवसत्तम O best among kings,

40021864.author: Translation
40021864.content: The greatly effulgent one, who was cursed by Bhrigu in a previous birth, has indeed come here to be your son, O best among kings.

40021865.author: पदार्थः
40021865.content: राम Rama, इत्यभिविख्यातस् thus renowned, त्रिषु in the three, लोकेषु worlds, मानद O giver of honor, तत्फलं that fruit/consequence, प्राप्स्यते will obtain, च and, अपि also, भृगुशापकृतं caused by Bhrigu's curse, महत् great,

40021865.author: Translation
40021865.content: He will be renowned as Rama in the three worlds, O giver of honor, and will also obtain the great consequence caused by Bhrigu's curse.

40021866.author: पदार्थः
40021866.content: अयोध्यायाः of Ayodhya, पती the lord, रामो Rama, दीर्घकालं for a long time, भविष्यति will be, सुखिनश्च and happy, समृद्धाश्च and prosperous, भविष्यन्ति will be, अस्य his, ये who, अनुगाः followers,

40021866.author: Translation
40021866.content: Rama will be the lord of Ayodhya for a long time, and his followers will be happy and prosperous.

40021867.author: पदार्थः
40021867.content: दश ten, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, दश ten, वर्षशतानि hundreds of years, च and, रामो Rama, राज्यम् the kingdom, उपासित्वा having ruled, ब्रह्मलोकं to the world of Brahma, गमिष्यति will go,

40021867.author: Translation
40021867.content: Rama, having ruled the kingdom for eleven thousand years, will then go to the world of Brahma.

40021868.author: पदार्थः
40021868.content: समृद्धैश्च and with prosperous, अश्वमेधैश्च and with Ashwamedha sacrifices, इष्ट्वा having performed sacrifices, परमदुर्जयः extremely unconquerable, राजवंशांश्च and royal lineages, बहुशो many times, बहून् many, संस्थापयिष्यति will establish,

40021868.author: Translation
40021868.content: The extremely unconquerable Rama, having performed many prosperous Ashwamedha sacrifices, will establish many royal lineages in various places.

40021869.author: पदार्थः
40021869.content: द्वौ two, पुत्रौ sons, तु indeed, भविष्येते will be born, सीतायां in Sita, राघवस्य of Rama, तु indeed, अन्यत्र elsewhere, न not, त्वयोध्यायां in Ayodhya, सत्यम् truth, एतत् this, न no, संशयः doubt

40021869.author: Translation
40021869.content: Two sons will indeed be born to Rama through Sita, but they will be born elsewhere and not in Ayodhya; this is the truth, without a doubt.

40021870.author: पदार्थः
40021870.content: सीतायाश्च and of Sita, ततः then, पुत्रौ two sons, अभिषेक्ष्यति will anoint, राघवः Rama

40021870.author: Translation
40021870.content: Then, Rama will anoint Sita's two sons (as kings).

40021871.author: पदार्थः
40021871.content: स he, सर्वम् all, अखिलम् complete, राज्ञः of the king, वंशस्य of the lineage, आह told, गतागतम् past and future, आख्याय having narrated, सुमहातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, तूष्णीम् silent, आसीत् became, महामुनिः the great sage

40021871.author: Translation
40021871.content: Having narrated the entire past and future of the king's lineage, the greatly effulgent great sage then became silent.

40021872.author: पदार्थः
40021872.content: तूष्णीम्भूते when silent became, तदा then, तस्मिन् that, राजा king, दशरथः Dasharatha, मुनौ sage, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानौ the two great souls, पुनरायात् returned again, पुरोत्तमम् to the best of cities

40021872.author: Translation
40021872.content: When that sage became silent, King Dasharatha, having saluted the great sage, then returned to the excellent city (Ayodhya).

40021873.author: पदार्थः
40021873.content: एतत् this, वचः word, मया by me, तत्र there, मुनिना by the sage, व्याहृतम् spoken, पुरा formerly, श्रुतम् heard, हृदि in the heart, च and, निक्षिप्तम् placed, न not, अन्यथा otherwise, तत् that, भविष्यति will be

40021873.author: Translation
40021873.content: This word, spoken by the sage there formerly, was heard by me and placed in my heart, and it will not be otherwise.

40021874.author: पदार्थः
40021874.content: एवं thus, गते having happened, न not, सन्तापं sorrow, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought, राघव O Raghava, सीतार्थे for Sita's sake, राघवार्थे for Raghava's sake, वा or, दृढो firm, भव be, नरोत्तम O best among men,

40021874.author: Translation
40021874.content: O Raghava, since things have come to this pass, you should not grieve, but rather be resolute, whether for Sita's sake or for your own, O best among men.

40021875.author: पदार्थः
40021875.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, व्याहृतं spoken, वाक्यं word, सूतस्य of the charioteer, परमाद्भुतम् exceedingly wonderful, प्रहर्षम् joy, अतुलं incomparable, लेभे obtained, साधु excellent, साधु excellent, इति thus, च and, अब्रवीत् he said,

40021875.author: Translation
40021875.content: Having heard the charioteer's exceedingly wonderful words, he felt incomparable joy and exclaimed, "Excellent, excellent!"

40021876.author: पदार्थः
40021876.content: ततः then, संवदतोरेवं while thus conversing, सूतलक्ष्मणयोः of the charioteer and Lakshmana, पथि on the path, अस्तम् setting, अर्के the sun, गते having gone, वासम् dwelling, केशिन्यां in Keshini, तावथ then they two, उषतुः stayed,

40021876.author: Translation
40021876.content: Then, as the charioteer and Lakshmana were conversing on the path, the sun set, and they stayed in Keshini for the night. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 51 ।। Thus ends the fifty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
